name: Walter Baumer
features: fair skin, blond hair, blue eyes, broad face, heavy build, quiet unassuming expression
bio: A BMW sports car specialist whose greatest day came in the 1940 Mille Miglia, shared with Huschke von Hanstein in the BMW 328 Kamm coupé that won outright. Bäumer died in 1941 while the war was still on, in an accident on the road rather than a circuit.
